video:video.video:title: AI interactive story maker — create, play & remix | Relay
video:video.video:description: Relay is a free experimental AI interactive story maker for adults. Create a fictional story with three decisions, two options per decision and four possible endings. Edit an editorial starter or request an AI draft, preview it, then create an unlisted link that friends can play and remix without an account.

video:video.video:title: AI 互动故事生成器：创作、试玩、分享与改编 | 接力
video:video.video:description: 接力是面向成年用户的免费 AI 互动故事创作实验。每个故事包含三次决定、每次两个选项和四种可能结局。你可以改写编辑示例，也可以请求 AI 草稿，检查并试玩后生成不进入公开列表的链接；朋友无需注册即可游玩和改编。
